comments.content: The relocated tests replace `Element.prototype.scrollIntoView` without restoring it. Unlike `vi.spyOn`, this direct assignment is not undone by `vi.restoreAllMocks()`, so later tests in the same environment inherit this mock and can produce order-dependent results. Preserve the original property descriptor and restore it (or delete the property if originally absent) in `afterEach`, as the original suite does.
